summary: Iteration 16: P0 bug testing complete. Backend APIs (24/24 tests PASSED): All CRUD operations for activation codes and intervention codes work correctly. Role switching API works correctly. Frontend: Role switching UI verified working - Claire can switch from guardian to beneficiary mode and dashboard content updates (SOS button, health cards, different tab bar). Admin backoffice: Modal for creating codes appears and is functional, but the codes LIST does not render in the Codes tab due to authentication state issue when navigating directly to /backoffice.

ui_bugs.issue: Codes list is empty (shows only Create button) - 401 errors in console suggest authentication state is lost when navigating to /backoffice directly. The codes API requires admin token but the page seems to lose auth context.

integration_issues.issue: API call to /api/admin/activation-codes returns 401 when accessed via direct /backoffice URL navigation. The useAuth token may not be persisting correctly on page navigation.

action_items: Investigate why /api/admin/activation-codes returns 401 in frontend but works in backend tests - possible token persistence issue on page navigation
Check if AuthContext token is available when backoffice.tsx useEffect runs apiFetch calls
